title: Field signal sieve and decision canvas for Sales/CS enterprise asks
creator: Marcus Li
description: Goal: build a lightweight, repeatable rubric and one-page decision canvas that Sales and CS can use to submit, cluster, and get a first-pass scope for enterprise (non-bug) feature requests. This ticket defines the sieve criteria, the fields the canvas must capture, and a proposed 10-minute intake flow for frontline reps so PMs can make confident go/no-go decisions or pass items to solution discovery. The outcome is reduced back-and-forth, faster time-to-triage, and clearer economic/infra signals for prioritization.
background: We receive high-volume, heterogeneous asks from high-touch accounts: feature variants, security/compliance tweaks for Private deployments, Dedicated capacity behavior changes, and new API ergonomics. Current intake is ad-hoc: lengthy emails, inconsistent context, and missed cost/infra implications. Existing artifacts in product backlog are fragmented which slows PM decisions and raises expectation misalignment with Sales/CS.
objective: Create a short form + decision canvas that (1) standardizes the minimum context Sales/CS must provide, (2) produces a triage score (value, implementation risk, infra impact), and (3) suggests one of three outcomes: Quick Fix (<=2 wks), Scoped Discovery (2-6 wks), Enterprise Track (requires cross-functional scoping & negotiated econ).
scope: In scope: intake form fields, triage scoring algorithm, example filled forms for 6 typical enterprise scenarios, integration hooks to Slack and Confluence, and a lightweight CS/Sales training doc. Out of scope: build UI in Console, billing changes, and full engineering estimates (those roll to discovery).
acceptance_criteria: - A one-page decision canvas template available in Confluence.
acceptance_criteria_2: - A 10-minute intake playflow documented with sample emails and Slack blocks.
acceptance_criteria_3: - A triage scoring spreadsheet that yields consistent outcome labels for >80% of historical asks in a retrospective test set.
work_items: Iterate canvas based on workshop feedback
decision_heuristics: Primary dimensions: Customer value (1-5), Revenue/expansion potential (1-5), Implementation complexity (1-5), Infra/ops impact (1-5), Regulatory/compliance need (binary: yes/no). Outcome thresholds map to Quick Fix (score >=X and infra impact <=Y), Scoped Discovery, or Enterprise Track. Include quick checks: 'Is this blocked by infra or data access?' and 'Does customer require private deployment or KMS integration?'.
tradeoffs: We prioritize speed over precision for first pass triage; the canvas must be concise to avoid burdening reps. This will mean certain nuanced infra dependencies may be under-specified and require follow-up discovery. We'll mitigate by flagging high-risk infra and forcing a discovery handoff.
risks:
- Under-capture of security/regulatory constraints leading to rework.
- Sales gaming the form to bump priority.
- Overhead on CS if form is too heavy.
mitigations: Pre-fillable account metadata, mandatory infra flag fields, role-based training, and a monitoring pulse to measure average time-to-decision after adoption.
notes: Workshop scheduled 2025-02-05 with 8 reps from Sales and CS. Initial feedback favored a scorecard over free-text prioritization. Reps requested examples for 'Dedicated capacity change' vs 'API ergonomics'.
